# How the Dependency Array Controls the Effect

#### Course: React Hooks: Level Up Your First Web App

## How the Dependency Array Controls the Effect

React re-runs the effect after a render only if at least one dependency has changed.

It compares the current value of each dependency to its previous value. If any value is different, the effect runs again.

![Effects of Dependency Array](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

The empty array [] we have been using means there are no dependencies.

React checks the list, finds nothing to compare, and concludes that the effect never needs to re-run after the first mount. That's why the fetch only happens once.

Now let's use this to build the Refresh button.
